value.rationale: A full classification of which signed evidence/classicality trajectories are globally realizable settles a natural finite-depth entailment problem arising directly from the minimal semantics. The induced complete signed-positive quotient by upset lattices on explicit finite posets gives exact logical equivalence and consequence for all positive combinations, with nontrivial class counts 83 and 70,806. Its unbounded counterpart clarifies the difference between independence of positive flags and constraints on signed evidence. This is a reusable structural decision model rather than a disconnected finite census or an old non-finite-matrix observation.
